cs.t: Not cheap but amazing + not a ripoff considering what you get:  https://www.flobeds.com  I love mine. As a piece of furniture which gets used 6-10 hours per day, I didn't mind spending a significant amount for something nice. Edit: I came to this conclusion after a few weeks of intense research. I looked into all the Casper / Leesa / Tuft and Needle (and almost got a Leesa). I also got the wool cover for the top layer, which works well for me since I sleep hot. After another large search for bedding, I ended up with Parachute linen and Macy's Hotel Collection pillows. It's been great. Moving with this bed was also easy since each piece rolls up into a contractor garbage bag which can be easily carried.
